pin_status.3: inner=p1 (smaller-norm criterion; C879 attribution for legal tuples)

strict_hub_norm_margin.note: |h_A| <= |b_A| + eps_A and |h_B| <= |b_B| + eps_B for every feasible hub; both must be < 1 - r (strict hub). NOTE: |p_out| = 1 holds in the exact candidate CHART, not at the rounded nominal centres -- no equality is claimed at the nominal data, only the numerical margin below. so this strictness is load-bearing (C879 boundary case).

delta0_w0.radicand_branch_semantics: radicands may cross 0 on the box (central circle r^2-|AC|^2/4 and localisation r^2-V). The certificate is stated per tuple as a BRANCH: either (i) |AC| > 2r strictly, where the crescent is empty because rho >= |AC|/2 > r; or (ii) V > r^2, where no hub exists; or (iii) the corresponding exclusion holds with the clamped upper-end radius.  NOTE (auditor correction): the boundary case |AC| = 2r (k = 0) is NOT excluded by the rho-argument (rho >= r does not contradict rho <= r); there q_near = q_far = m, the product identity degenerates to 4y^2(rho^2-r^2) = (|b-m|^2-r^2)^2, and such tuples are excluded by the STRICT G bound itself (|b_B - m| - eps_B > r inside the localisation ball).  Collinear (a,b,c_i) tuples have no circumradius and lie outside the C900 all-cover-graph non-collinear necessary domain -- they are not treated as vacuously true.
delta0_w0.result: CERTIFIED (uniform distal exclusion, both central faces)
